column2: select(title, year, your_rating, IMDb_Rating, runtime_mins, num_votes) %>%
year_score = score_linear(year, Fun_List$year, score_config$year$range, score_config$year$max_score, power = score_config$year$power),
my_score = score_linear(your_rating, Fun_List$my, score_config$my$range, score_config$my$max_score, power = score_config$my$power),
public_score = score_linear(IMDb_Rating, Fun_List$pub, score_config$pub$range, score_config$pub$max_score, power = score_config$pub$power),
time_score = score_relative(runtime_mins, Fun_List$run, score_config$run$range, score_config$run$max_score, power = score_config$run$power),
vote_score = score_relative(num_votes, Fun_List$vot, score_config$vot$range, score_config$vot$max_score, power = score_config$vot$power)
mutate(total = year_score + my_score + public_score + time_score + vote_score) %>%
subtitle = "Films where their stats are closest to this dataset's average"
